comments: Agent1 is the initiator and ego is the responder (input facts). Assumptions: opposing straight approaches at a four-way intersection; after 1 second of approach at 5–7 m/s agent1 accelerates toward 11–14 m/s while following a leftward deflection across ego's straight path. A conflicting left-turn connector represents the loss-of-control displacement kinematically; tire dynamics are not modeled. Ego approaches at 7–9 m/s and continues for 0.7 seconds after detecting agent1 within 16–20 m before braking. Initial partner separation is 22–48 m. Opportunity for conflict is intended; collision is not required.
